name: Ball Guys : Stumble & Fall
summary:
Ball Guys: Stumble & Fall is a fast-paced physics platformer where chaotic movement meets creative Powers and community-driven madness.

The newest hit mode, Merge, turns the action into a wildly addictive live-event experience. Combine Balls, trigger massive chain reactions, and climb toward bigger multipliers while viewers and players influence the chaos in real time. It is simple to start, hard to master, and endlessly satisfying to watch and play.

Then there is The Cannon. Launch your Ball, chase distance records, dominate the leaderboard, and unlock rewards. It became a viral favorite thanks to its strangely satisfying momentum and competitive glory factor.

With hundreds of Adventure levels, experimental PvP Battles, streamer-powered events, and constant updates shaped by the community, Ball Guys is a physics playground where skill, strategy, and chaos collide.
